description: The municipality of Bari publishes Colibrì neighbourhood library network. Colibrì is described as a neighbourhood-library network distributed across 11 districts with a common digital catalogue and public-access platform. The metadata describes physical library spaces, disability access and areas for children and adolescents. These statements identify the facility network, without independently verifying accessibility, capacity or present service. The accompanying app is not catalogued as a simulation platform. Coverage is Bari, Italy. The native package and its distributions retain their original identities. The provider lists CSV representations. Archive contents and data rows were not read. The native catalogue declares a Creative Commons Attribution licence without a version; file-use charges and download conditions are not established. Metadata timestamps do not prove observation dates or present operation. Accuracy, completeness and current availability of individual features remain unverified. No specific simulation use is assigned. Related publications are linked through their exact metadata records; shared hosting alone does not establish equivalence.
